clue.text: Pop into lounge for a meal

indicators.note: into tells us one piece goes inside the other here

parts.note: to lounge is to rest
pop is an informal word for father, pa

explanation.surface: Someone drops into a lounge bar to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop into' reads as a phrase meaning drop in for a visit, but Pop is a noun for father and 'into' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a formal or literary word for a meal or feast.

clue.text: River crossed by burning bridges

parts.note: Caesar's crossing of this Italian stream was the irrevocable step, like burning one's bridges

explanation.surface: A river spanned by bridges that are on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossing this Italian river committed Caesar to civil war, the classic point of no return.

clue.text: Display for long time in food store

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: a pantry is a room for storing food
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: Food left on show in the larder for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Pageantry is elaborate ceremonial show or spectacle.

clue.text: Gloomy doctor put in a sensitive spot

indicators.note: put in places one piece inside another

parts.note: a sore is a tender, painful place
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A doctor glumly prods a tender part.
explanation.definitionFit: Sombre means dark and melancholy in mood.

clue.text: The easiest word may be misspelt

indicators.note: may be signals that the following word could be rearranged into a different spelling

explanation.surface: A remark that even the easiest word can be spelt wrongly.
explanation.walkthrough: The word misspelt, when its letters are jumbled as 'may be' suggests, spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Simplest is the superlative of simple, meaning least difficult.

clue.text: Is including two names for pubs

indicators.note: including means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: taken as written
N abbreviates name, so two names give NN

explanation.surface: A remark that a place has two names for its bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Inns are taverns or public houses offering drink and lodging.

clue.text: Jam book under piano

indicators.note: under in a down answer places this word below the other

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
to book a table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A jar of jam left beneath a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: Preserve is fruit cooked with sugar, a synonym for jam.

clue.text: Make a run to clinch the match

definitions.text: Make a run to clinch the match

parts.words: Make a run to clinch the match
parts.note: lovers running away secretly to marry; match means marriage, not a game

explanation.surface: A cricketer scores the winning run.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly in order to get married.

clue.text: Speaker of high tone

parts.note: a loudspeaker unit handling treble frequencies

explanation.surface: Someone who talks in a posh manner.
explanation.definitionFit: In audio, this is the small speaker that reproduces high frequencies.

clue.text: Generous girl having two husbands?

parts.note: a generous helping is a big one
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A big-hearted woman who happens to be married twice over.
explanation.definitionFit: Bigamy is the state of being married to two people at once; the question mark flags the loose phrasing.

clue.text: Cover note might be put into this

definitions.text: Cover note might be put into this

parts.words: Cover note might be put into this
parts.note: a covering letter or note is slipped into a paper wrapper before posting

explanation.surface: Where an insurer's cover note gets filed.
explanation.definitionFit: A paper sleeve that holds a letter for posting is exactly what a cover note would be put inside.

clue.text: Muzak a right blend for music to dance to?

indicators.note: blend means the letters are mixed together into a new order

explanation.surface: Background music mixed up to make dance music.
explanation.definitionFit: A mazurka is a lively Polish dance and the music written for it.

clue.text: Yet he enjoys some standing at meetings

definitions.text: Yet he enjoys some standing at meetings

parts.words: Yet he enjoys some standing at meetings
parts.note: the one presiding is the person who sits throughout yet has the status

explanation.surface: A paradox about someone who sits down in meetings but has standing.
explanation.walkthrough: Standing means status, not being on one's feet: the person in charge sits in the chair.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who presides over a meeting has high standing even though seated.

clue.text: Join me in the money

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other

parts.note: a cent is a small unit of money
taken as written

explanation.surface: An invitation to share in some cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To cement things is to bind or join them firmly together.

clue.text: Confirm a wild animal has escaped

definitions.meaning: to support or corroborate a claim
read literally, the phrase says a bear is on the loose

explanation.surface: A report that a dangerous beast is on the loose.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means corroborate, and literally describes a bear that is loose.

clue.text: Stagger back, deprived of one's wits

indicators.note: back tells us the word for stagger is read the other way round

parts.note: to stagger someone is to stun or astonish them

explanation.surface: Someone reels backwards having lost their senses.
explanation.walkthrough: Stagger here means amaze, not totter.
explanation.definitionFit: Being nuts is informal for having lost one's reason, so crazy.

clue.text: Splendid face-saving feature for a manager

parts.note: super is a dated exclamation meaning splendid
a visor protects the face on a helmet

explanation.surface: Praise for a manager who knows how to save face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face-saving' suggests avoiding embarrassment; here it is literal protection of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A supervisor oversees staff, the role of a manager.

clue.text: Girl has an unusual idea of earthly paradise

indicators.note: unusual suggests the letters are put into an odd order

explanation.surface: A girl with a quirky notion of heaven on earth.
explanation.definitionFit: The name comes from a hidden Himalayan utopia in a novel, now any idyllic retreat.

clue.text: In-joke about southern rustic

indicators.note: about here means one piece goes around another

parts.note: being in means being at home
a pun is a joke on words

explanation.surface: An in-joke about the South.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In-joke' reads as a single word for a private joke; it must be split, with 'about' wrapping the two parts around the southern letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Homespun means plain and unsophisticated, like rustic home-made cloth.

clue.text: Computer operators are indispensable members of the staff

definitions.meaning: people who work at keyboards keying in data
essential workers whose jobs cannot be dropped

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both people who key data in and staff whose work is essential.

clue.text: One providing cast-off clothing?

parts.note: casting off is the final step in making a woollen garment, not discarding clothes

explanation.surface: A charity donor handing over old clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who makes garments with needles and yarn casts off stitches to finish them.

clue.text: Mother, I'm seriously hurt!

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
taken as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A cry of distress to Mum after an injury.
explanation.definitionFit: To maim is to injure badly, often disabling permanently.

clue.text: Ring-fighter likely to produce a pass when charged

definitions.text: Ring-fighter likely to produce a pass when charged

parts.words: Ring-fighter likely to produce a pass when charged
parts.note: in the bullring, a fighter sweeps the cape past a charging bull

explanation.surface: A boxer who dodges when rushed.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal bullfighter makes passes with the cape as the bull charges.

clue.text: Cook last of the cheese on part of the barbecue

parts.note: to grill is to cook under or over direct heat

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Instructions to toast the end of the cheese on the barbecue.
explanation.definitionFit: A grille is a metal grating, such as the rack on a barbecue.

clue.text: Not out to use deception to go to university in place of another

parts.note: in cricket a batter not out is in
to lie is to deceive

explanation.surface: Someone lies their way into a university place meant for another.
explanation.definitionFit: The French-derived phrase means instead of, as a substitute for something.

clue.text: Loss of water, we hear, in vegetables

indicators.note: we hear means the word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: leaks are escapes of water

explanation.surface: Water seeping out of the vegetable patch.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeks are onion-family vegetables with long white stems.

clue.text: Completely wrong direction

parts.note: a guess that is out is wrong
right is a direction to turn

explanation.surface: Someone has taken entirely the wrong turning.
explanation.definitionFit: Outright means wholly or utterly, without reservation.

clue.text: Cooked meal of game

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are messed about, as in cooking the books

explanation.surface: A dish made from game birds.
explanation.walkthrough: Game is an adjective meaning crippled, as in a game leg, not wild animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A game leg is a lame one: both mean injured or limping.

clue.text: The spell of time I put in as an actor

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: put in places one piece inside another

parts.note: a span is a stretch or spell of time

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a stint they spent as a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A thespian is a formal or jocular word for an actor, after Thespis of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Everything that is finally told or related

parts.note: all means everything
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word told

explanation.surface: Once all is said and told, things are connected.
explanation.definitionFit: Allied means joined or connected, so related in kind.

clue.text: Need rest perhaps when taken ill

indicators.note: perhaps indicates the words might appear in another arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone under the weather probably needs a lie-down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taken ill' means taken badly, offended, not sick.
explanation.definitionFit: If you take something ill you take offence at it, which is to have resented it.

clue.text: Couple again seen in resort

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: A couple reunited at a holiday resort.
explanation.walkthrough: Resort is a verb here: to repair to a place is to go there. 'Couple again' builds re-pair, so 'seen in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair somewhere is an old-fashioned way to say go or resort there.
